scripts.setup: node -e "const f=require('fs');for(const d of ['api','web','mobile'])f.existsSync(d+'/.env')||!f.existsSync(d)||f.copyFileSync(d+'/.env.example',d+'/.env')" && npm install && npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix api && npm run typecheck --prefix web && npm run typecheck --prefix mobile
